title: Ready-made templates to customize
sites: https://www.originkit.dev/
Pick nice page sections and get code for AI to edit. Some parts are free; usage limits apply.
https://21st.dev/
Pick buttons, cards and menus. Get code or a prompt for AI; number of copies depends on plan.
https://www.shadcnblocks.com/
Get headers, pricing tables or FAQs for AI to edit. Free and paid templates available.

title: Pick a nice template, get a prompt for AI
sites: https://www.getlayers.ai/
Pick a template and get a prompt for AI to rebuild it. Code download and commercial use depend on plan.
https://motionsites.ai/
Get animated pages with prompts for AI. Template access depends on plan.
https://www.aura.build/templates
Pick a template, then let AI adjust it. Some templates are paid; code export depends on plan.

title: Ready-made effects for websites
sites: https://reactbits.dev/
Pick an effect and get code for AI to add. Made for React projects.
https://ui.aceternity.com/
Pick cards, backgrounds or effects, then copy the code. Free templates and paid packs.
https://magicui.design/
Pick page effects, then copy the code. The library is free; Pro is sold separately.

title: Ready-made buttons, menus and tables
sites: https://ui.shadcn.com/
Get buttons, inputs or tables, then adjust them. Free; your project must be compatible.
https://daisyui.com/
Pick buttons, menus and color sets for Tailwind CSS. The core library is free.
https://flowbite.com/
Get buttons, tables and inputs for Tailwind. The core is free; interactivity needs JS.

title: Find good layouts for websites
sites: https://land-book.com/
Browse sample websites to learn layouts. Advanced filters are in the Pro plan.
https://www.lapa.ninja/
Browse landing pages to choose how to place text and images. Downloadable resources have their own terms.
https://www.curated.design/
Pick good-looking websites for AI to learn layouts from. Some features are Pro.

title: Find styles and user flows
sites: https://www.siteinspire.com/
Find websites in a style you like, then give them to AI as references.
https://www.dark.design/
Browse dark-background websites to choose how to combine text, images and colors.
https://mobbin.com/
See screens and user flows from real apps. The full library needs a paid plan.

title: Consistent icons, cleaner interface
sites: https://lucide.dev/icons/
Pick thin outline icons and copy the code. Free and open source.
https://phosphoricons.com/
Choose thin, bold, filled or two-tone styles. Free.
https://heroicons.com/
Pick outline or filled icons, then copy the code. Free and open source.

title: Choose fonts and pair them more easily
sites: https://fonts.google.com/
Pick a font, download it or get the code to add it to your site. Free.
https://www.fontshare.com/
Free fonts for personal and commercial projects. Check Vietnamese accent support.
https://www.typewolf.com/
See which fonts websites use and how they pair them. Suggested fonts may be paid.

title: Choose colors and try them on a design
sites: https://coolors.co/
Create color palettes or browse ready-made ones. Free and Pro versions.
https://www.realtimecolors.com/
Try colors on backgrounds, text and buttons, then copy the color codes and CSS.
https://www.radix-ui.com/colors
Pick shades for light or dark backgrounds. You still need to check text color.

title: Illustrations in one consistent style
sites: https://undraw.co/illustrations
Pick a color and download illustrations. Free, no credit needed.
https://storyset.com/
Pick an image, change its colors, then download. The free version needs credit.
https://www.humaaans.com/
Combine people and outfits into scenes. The original library is free.

title: Create backgrounds that match your site colors
sites: https://haikei.app/
Create wave and shape backgrounds in your chosen colors. Download as SVG or PNG.
https://www.svgbackgrounds.com/
Pick a background and adjust colors. Free backgrounds need credit; paid plans available.
https://www.fffuel.co/
Create shapes and patterns, then download SVG. For personal and commercial use.

title: Find photos and videos for your content
sites: https://unsplash.com/
Find photos for your website. Free photos plus a paid Plus library.
https://www.pexels.com/
Find photos and videos for articles and page backgrounds. Free; check the license.
https://pixabay.com/
Find photos, videos and illustrations by topic. Free; check the license.

title: Place your design inside a device frame
sites: https://shots.so/
Place images in presentation frames. Free and paid features.
https://mockupbro.com/
Pick a frame, swap in your image, then download. Check the license of the template you use.
https://mockuphone.com/
Put screenshots into device frames. Free, credit required.

title: Ready-made 3D images, used like normal images
sites: https://shapefest.com/
Images of 3D shapes and objects. Free packs available; larger images are paid.
https://icons8.com/illustrations
Download 3D images from an illustration library. The free version is limited and needs credit.
https://old.3dicons.co/
3D icons for features. The V1 set is free for commercial use.

title: Add interactive 3D to your website
sites: https://spline.design/
Build 3D scenes visually, then embed them on the web. The free plan has a watermark.
https://modelviewer.dev/
Let visitors rotate an existing 3D model. Does not create new models.
https://www.vectary.com/
Build 3D scenes and product configurators. Web embedding and commercial use depend on plan.

title: Building blocks for 3D scenes
sites: https://polyhaven.com/
Download 3D objects, surfaces and lighting. Free for commercial use.
https://ambientcg.com/
Download wood and stone surfaces and 3D lighting. Free under CC0.
https://kenney.nl/assets
Simple 3D objects and buildings. Free, good for game-style scenes.

title: Ready-made animated images and icons
sites: https://lucide-animated.com/
Animated icons for React websites. Get the code for free, then let AI add it.
https://lordicon.com/
Pick animated icons for your site. The free set needs credit.
https://rive.app/marketplace/
Animations that react to hover or clicks. Needs the Rive runtime; check the license.

title: Control animation with code
sites: https://gsap.com/
Create scroll and click animations. Free under the GSAP license.
https://motion.dev/
Add animation to your interface. The core library is free; Motion+ is paid.
https://animejs.com/
Animate text and shapes. Free, with examples for AI to follow.

title: See unusual effects and learn how they are made
sites: https://codepen.io/
See demos and try the code. Public code is MIT; images and fonts have their own licenses.
https://tympanus.net/codrops/
Read tutorials and see interface demos. Code rights depend on each resource.
https://www.hoverstat.es/
See websites with unusual interactions. For reference only, not a code library.

title: Change colors and fonts so the site looks consistent
sites: https://tweakcn.com/editor/theme
Try colors and fonts on a live sample. Get the config for AI to apply to your site.
https://zippystarter.com/tools/shadcn-ui-theme-generator
Create color sets for shadcn/ui. Give the config to AI to recolor everything consistently.
https://www.shadcn.io/theme-generator
See colors on many sample interfaces. Get the config for shadcn/ui sites.

title: Choose font sizes and spacing
sites: https://typescale.com/
Choose font sizes by level. CSS export and advanced features are Pro.
https://utopia.fyi/
Create font sizes and spacing that scale with the screen. Includes CSS for AI to apply.
https://www.modularscale.com/
Enter a base font size and a ratio. Get the numbers to size each heading level.

title: Optimize images before putting them online
sites: https://squoosh.app/
Compress images for free on your own computer. Compare quality before saving the smaller file.
https://www.iloveimg.com/
Crop and resize many images at once. Files are uploaded to their server.
https://www.photopea.com/
Edit images in layers when you need more detail. Basic editing is free.

title: Add sample data so the site doesn't look empty
sites: https://www.mockaroo.com/
Create fake data by column, then download it. Free up to 1,000 rows per file.
https://dummyjson.com/docs/products
Product data for prototypes. Ask AI to fill it into cards and lists.
https://www.dicebear.com/playground/
Create avatars for sample accounts. Check the license of each style.

title: Loading, empty and error states too
sites: https://github.com/dvtng/react-loading-skeleton
Add loading placeholders to React sites. Includes sample code for AI to add to your project.
https://www.patternfly.org/components/empty-state/
See examples of pages with no data yet. Add an explanation and a next-step button.
https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/error-summary/
See how to show form errors. Ask AI to clearly point out which field to fix and how.

title: Check your site before sharing the link
sites: https://webaim.org/resources/contrastchecker/
Enter text and background colors to check contrast. Free.
https://wave.webaim.org/
Find warnings that make a page hard to use. Ask AI to review each issue.
https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/device-mode
Simulate small screens to find overflow and broken layouts. Built into Chrome.
